basics.name: Umair Manzoor
basics.label: Systems & Software Engineer
basics.summary: Systems & Software Engineer with 2+ years of production experience engineering high-concurrency client-server architectures, AWS cloud backends, and low-latency C++20 systems. Proven track record architecting backend infrastructure for 50M+ users at GenITeam, shipping commercial releases on Steam, and designing zero-allocation memory allocators and matching engines from scratch.

work.name: ZnK / GenITeam
work.summary: Architecting high-scale client-server systems, AWS cloud backends, and core game architectures.
highlights: Architected AWS cloud services for Scary Teacher short drama/reels platform handling high-throughput video delivery across 50M+ downloads.
Main Code Engineer for commercial Steam title 'Little King Unchained' (state machines, loop controllers, input pipelines).
Profiled and eliminated memory churn on Android devices, stabilizing frametimes at a consistent 60 FPS.
Deployed automated telemetry and live-ops performance pipelines.

work.name: EnsembleUI
work.summary: Contributed to declarative open-source cross-platform runtime in Flutter/Dart.
highlights: Optimized core widget rendering pipelines by ~2% via draw call batching and render caching.
Authored production-ready template architectures and asynchronous data-loading patterns.
Maintained modular package architecture across auth, storage, and networking in Melos monorepo.

work.name: UET Game Studio
work.summary: Engineered real-time simulation interaction systems for medical education VR software on mobile VR hardware.
highlights: Engineered real-time VR simulation systems for medical training.
Optimized mobile graphics budgets, shipping 2 interactive titles with 10K+ downloads.

projects.name: Holt
projects.description: Ultra-low latency electronic matching engine built in C++20 for deterministic sub-microsecond throughput using wait-free SPSC ring buffers and zero dynamic heap allocations on the hot path.

projects.name: Mem-Allocator
projects.description: Deterministic custom memory allocator suite (Linear Bump, LIFO Stack with markers, Intrusive Free-List Pool) eliminating runtime heap fragmentation with Raylib visualizer and Doctest suite.

projects.name: ECS
projects.description: Data-oriented archetype Entity Component System in C++20 with packed contiguous parallel column arrays and O(1) swap-and-pop entity deletions.
